units.source_text: 是年秋，源氏在三公主住处西边的走廊前面，中垣的东面一带地方造成一片原野的模样，

en.t: That autumn, Genji made the area in front of the west corridor of the Third Princess's residence, on the east side of the inner fence, look like a stretch of wild moorland,

units.source_text: 又增筑供佛的净水棚，使这环境适合于尼僧的居处，景象十分幽雅。

en.t: and he also added a shelf for pure water offerings to the Buddha, making the place suitable as a nun's dwelling and giving it an exceptionally elegant air.

units.source_text: 许多人步三公主后尘，出家为尼，当了她的徒弟。

en.t: Many women followed the Third Princess's example, took vows as nuns, and became her disciples.

units.source_text: 其中乳母及老年侍女当然听其自愿，青年侍女则选取道心坚定而能终身不变者，许其出家。

en.t: Among them, the nurses and older gentlewomen were naturally allowed to follow their own wishes, while among the younger attendants only those whose religious resolve was firm and lifelong were permitted to take vows.

units.source_text: 当三公主落发时，众侍女争先恐后，都想追随。

en.t: When the Third Princess cut off her hair, all the gentlewomen competed eagerly to follow her.

units.source_text: 但源氏闻之，劝导她们说：“这是使不得的！

en.t: But when Genji heard of it, he admonished them, saying, "This must not be done!

units.source_text: 只要略有几个信心不坚的人夹杂其间，便会使旁人受到妨碍而流传轻薄之名。”

en.t: If even a few people of uncertain faith are mixed in among you, they will hinder the others and spread a reputation for frivolity."

units.source_text: 结果有十余人改装为尼，服侍三公主。

en.t: In the end, a little over ten of them changed their dress, became nuns, and served the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 源氏命人捉许多秋虫来，放在这原野中。

en.t: Genji ordered people to catch many autumn insects and release them in this moorland.

units.source_text: 夕暮秋风凉爽之时，他就信步来此，名为听赏秋虫，实则对三公主还是不能忘怀，

en.t: At dusk, when the autumn wind was cool, he would stroll there casually, claiming that he had come to listen to and enjoy the autumn insects, though in truth he still could not forget the Third Princess,
and he said things that troubled her.

units.source_text: 三公主觉得此人如此用心，真乃出人意外，心中非常厌恶。

en.t: The Third Princess felt that such persistence from him was truly unexpected, and in her heart she found it deeply repellent.

units.source_text: 本来，源氏在众人前对三公主的态度虽不改，内心却显然为了那桩事情而深感不快，

en.t: Originally, although Genji did not change his manner toward the Third Princess in front of others, inwardly he was plainly deeply displeased because of that affair,
and his feelings had changed completely.

units.source_text: 三公主希望不再与他见面，因而发心出家，以为从此脱离关系，可以放心了。

en.t: The Third Princess hoped never to meet him again, and so she resolved to take religious vows, thinking that from then on she would be free of their connection and could be at peace.

units.source_text: 岂知他还是说这些话，使她痛苦不堪。

en.t: But unexpectedly, he still said such things, causing her unbearable distress.

units.source_text: 她想离此尘境，避入深山，但也不便正式提出。

en.t: She wanted to leave this dusty world behind and withdraw deep into the mountains, but it was not convenient for her to make such a formal request.
